newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Champion lowered to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Champion lowered to hold.

text.p: - Mesirow Financial said it removed Champion Enterprises Inc from its focus list and reduced its rating to a hold from a buy.
- The change is based on Champion's announcement of flat first quarter results of $0.28 a share compared with Mesirow's estimate of $0.32, Mesirow analyst Gary Prestopino said in a research note.
- Prestopino said he reduced his earnings estimates for Champion for 1997 and 1998 to $1.55-$1.60 and $1.84-$1.88, respectively, from previous estimates of $1.64 and $1.88.
